competitors.title: Perp DEX volumes have grown ~5x since early 2024, with open interest climbing from near zero to $10-
competitors.description:
Perp DEX volumes have grown ~5x since early 2024, with open interest climbing from near zero to $10-15B. Trading volume grew 346% in 2025 to $6.7 trillion, and DEXs now account for roughly 10% of all crypto perpetual swap volume.

What's driving the shift?

Self-custody and reduced counterparty risk, on chain transparency into liquidations and settlement, permissionless access to global liquidity, and latency that now rivals centralized exchanges.
